name: Notification event monitor
summary: Records when a notification is posted or removed for the apps you choose.
details: Uses Android's notification-access permission and listener service.
Each event is saved on your phone with the app, the time and the event type.
After a quiet period you can see when each app last reached your phone.
limits: NEXGUARD only sees notifications that Android delivers to it. A message that never reached your phone cannot be recovered.

name: Per-app control
summary: Choose which apps are monitored and review each one.
details: Search and filter your installed apps (all, user, system).
Switch monitoring on or off for each app.
On a new install, system apps start switched off and user apps on. Existing choices are kept when you update.
limits: Apps you switch off leave gaps in your history on purpose.

name: Local history and privacy modes
summary: A history stored only on your device, with the privacy level and retention you choose.
details: Metadata only is the recommended mode. Metadata plus titles is optional.
The full message text is not stored.
Choose how long history is kept and clear it with one tap.
limits: Backup of this data is switched off, so history does not move to a new phone.

name: Background diagnostics
summary: Checks notification access, monitoring state and battery policy.
details: Shows plain statuses for what Android reports.
Run a full check on demand, and NEXGUARD also checks in the background.
limits: Android does not let one app read another app's battery or autostart settings, so those stay for you to check.

name: Phone-specific guidance
summary: Guidance for phone brands that restrict background apps.
details: The app shows brand guidance, for example for OPPO and Realme ColorOS.
The website has a guide for each major brand.
limits: Menu names change between models and software versions.

name: Checks after restart
summary: Background checks are scheduled again after your phone restarts.
details: Built on Android WorkManager.
A boot receiver reschedules the work.
limits: Android decides the exact time and may delay background work to save battery.

name: Interface languages
summary: 25 language options, including right-to-left layouts. All app text is translated, but the translations are machine-generated and not yet reviewed by native speakers.
details: Languages: English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Hindi, Bengali, Punjabi, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean and Swahili.
Every one of the app's 115 text items has a translation in every language.
Choose a language on first launch and change it any time.
limits: Machine translation can be wrong or awkward, and some Android setting names may differ from what your phone shows. Long text may not fit every button. Native-speaker review is still to do.

name: Themes and comfort settings
summary: Four themes, reduced motion and haptic feedback.
details: Themes: Black, White, Golden and Black, Golden and White.
Switch haptics and reduced motion on or off in Settings.
